put.description: Items with an id are updated (their saved amount is kept, it follows the savings), items without one are created and the sub goals left out are removed (not allowed for a sub goal that has savings). The target amounts must add up to the goal target amount and the saved amounts to the goal saved amount; a desired_date cannot be later than the goal desired date.
